name: editor-and-helpers
description: An editor that delegates research and drafting to two helpers and decides when the result is good enough.

nodes.instruction: Produce release notes for the topic in your input. Ask the researcher for facts, then ask the drafter for a draft from them; check the draft cites its sources, and answer with it.

nodes.description: Finds facts on Tirraflow, with URLs.
nodes.instruction: Search Tirraflow for what the request asks and answer with short factual notes, each citing the article URL.

nodes.description: Drafts release notes through the remote writer.
nodes.instruction: Send the request, unchanged, to the demo writer's draft tool and answer with exactly the draft it returns.
